findings.title: No live scene-plan producer in Ready/Hide/Snap root
evidence: Ready app.js emits no taky:character-scene-plan
Hide app.js/hide-runtime.js emit no taky:character-scene-plan
Snap root app.js emits no taky:character-scene-plan
Only *-character-scene-bridge-v1.js listens for the event
findings.impact: TAKY Character Behavior/Scene engine does not actually govern live app behavior.

findings.title: No live activation consumer from UI binding plan to gated DOM binder
evidence: App code does not consume taky:character-ui-binding-plan
DOM binder modules exist but are not invoked by live app flow
findings.impact: Binding/DOM contracts are validated but not operational.

findings.title: Ready live Guide behavior bypasses TAKY behavior engine
evidence: Ready app.js GUIDE_TYPES = lumi/pico/mori local personalities
Home/recording/result copy is written directly in app.js
finishRecording() writes fixed duo dialogue
findings.impact: Explorer Crew canonical behavior is not the source of truth on Ready screens.

findings.title: Hide live partner behavior bypasses TAKY behavior engine
evidence: Hide app.js GUIDE_OPTIONS = fox/rabbit/raccoon/cat
setPartner() directly writes message/mood/avatar
many learning states call setPartner() with hard-coded dialogue
findings.impact: Central relationship/behavior semantics do not control Hide partner behavior.

findings.title: Snap root runtime is not using specialist Crew runtime
evidence: Snap root app.js uses fixed guideLine text
guideBtn reports crew/guide linkage is HOLD
Specialist crew-state/behavior/interaction runtime remains isolated under onboarding/
findings.impact: Snap is nominal crew owner but root production runtime is not yet migrated.

findings.title: Verified relationship/shared-memory state is not fed into live apps
evidence: TAKY relation_affinity_engine exists
Snap onboarding stores only LOCAL_CANDIDATE_NOT_CROSS_APP_VERIFIED events
Ready/Hide live runtimes do not commit central relationship state
findings.impact: KNOWN/FAMILIAR/TRUSTED does not materially affect current live Guide behavior.

findings.title: Ready Random Guest is implemented, but Smart Random is minimal
evidence: chooseGuest() excludes only the immediately recent guest then randomizes
Ready project contract calls for Smart Random with controlled-flex weights
findings.impact: Core random-guest concept is correct, but contextual weighting/history depth is incomplete.

findings.title: Ready recording feedback is not evidence-based Crew feedback
evidence: finishRecording() says automatic evaluation is not being done
No transcript/reference comparison or pronunciation evidence reaches Behavior Engine
Duo feedback is fixed text
findings.impact: Praise + one useful hint cannot yet be grounded in actual recording.

findings.title: One Good Reflection is not realized as Crew behavior in Ready live result flow
evidence: Family Learning OS requires one meaningful context-aware reflection
Ready resultSceneFor() produces result copy but no actual reflection question
findings.impact: Session closure does not yet return initiative through reflection.

findings.title: Silence by Default is central-only, not consistently enforced in live apps
evidence: Central Behavior Engine makes AMBIENT silent
Ready Focus mostly reduces Guide presence but home/recording copy is direct
Hide setPartner() updates partner text across many screens
findings.impact: Live intervention frequency is project hard-coded rather than centrally arbitrated.

findings.title: Live Ready/Hide Guide identities are not aligned to canonical Explorer Crew roster
evidence: Canonical Core6/Visual-ID crew is separate
Ready uses lumi/pico/mori local guide types
Hide uses fox/rabbit/raccoon/cat local guide options
findings.impact: Identity/relationship continuity across Ready/Hide/Snap cannot be guaranteed.

findings.title: Cross-app continuing companion continuity is not operational
evidence: App runtimes maintain independent local Guide state
No shared character_id relationship/session handoff producer-consumer path is active
findings.impact: Same companion cannot reliably carry identity/history between apps.

findings.title: Snap root reward/blessing path is not aligned with current badge-conditioned blessing policy
evidence: Snap root blessing spends gems directly
Current project rule requires certain blessings to unlock via self-directed-action badges
findings.impact: Not strictly a Crew behavior bug, but Crew/world reward semantics are inconsistent.

findings.title: Special Friend exists canonically but detailed runtime contract remains unverified
evidence: GUIDE_CHARACTER_RELATIONSHIP explicitly says SPECIAL FRIEND ≠ RANDOM GUEST and details RECOVERY_REQUIRED
findings.impact: Do not implement by analogy; preserve as OPEN.

findings.title: Ready Duo intro comedy has only one hard-coded variant
evidence: Current dialogue is 잡아왔다 + fixed guest line
findings.impact: Concept is valid, but character-specific wit/variation is not implemented.

findings.title: Behavior Engine action vocabulary is narrower than canonical ambient contract
evidence: Central action set mainly IDLE/READ_BOOK/READ_MAP/WRITE_NOTE/USE_RADIO/CHEER/THINK/POINT
Canonical ambient contract also names CHECK_COMPASS/ORGANIZE_BAG/USE_MAGNIFIER/REST
findings.impact: Some semantic ambient actions cannot yet be represented centrally.

findings.title: Chapter-owner precedence may overrule MAIN too broadly
evidence: character_behavior_engine selects chapter_owner before main whenever present
findings.impact: Needs scene-scoped owner_turn/owner_required semantics to avoid accidental Main displacement.

findings.title: Hide Guide visual mood system is local asset-state logic
evidence: guideAsset(mood) directly selects guide_default/smile/think/etc
findings.impact: Semantic action-to-approved-composition separation is bypassed in live Hide runtime.

findings.title: Ready recording filename/type semantics are hard-coded
evidence: filename always uses grammar recording; Bricks/Spelling Bee not represented
findings.impact: Not Crew logic itself, but recording context cannot yet drive contextual Crew feedback correctly.

preserved_or_pass: Child is protagonist / Guide is helper in canonical OS
Character identity must not change AI quality or functional ability
Relation engine reward/power/ability deltas are zero
Owner commit required before relationship promotion
Snap onboarding automatic affinity/reward/grade/answer are disabled
Ready Main Guide + exactly one Random Guest concept is preserved
Random Guest is not treated as Special Friend
Ready guest appears in result/share only after an actual recording guest event
Duo comedy currently does not target the child or a mistake
Voice/name changes in Ready do not explicitly reset task/recording/history state
recommended_order: P0-001 + P0-002: activate real event producer/consumer path without bypassing Design Gate
P0-003/P0-004/P0-005: route live app Guide behavior through TAKY semantic runtime; preserve project-specific presentation
P0-006: wire verified episode/relation state and shared character_id continuity
P1-005/P1-006: migrate live app local Guide IDs to canonical Explorer Crew IDs via compatibility mapping, not destructive reset
P1-002: add recording evidence adapter -> praise + one hint contract
P1-003/P1-004: One Good Reflection + Silence-by-Default runtime arbitration
P1-001/P2-002: upgrade Ready Smart Random and Duo intro variation
P2-003/P2-004/P2-005: ambient action coverage, chapter-owner scope, live visual composition boundary
constraints: Do not generate new art while LOGIC_ONLY_HOLD
Do not conflate Special Friend and Random Guest
Do not reset child history during identity migration
Do not auto-promote runtime screenshots to Golden
No main merge / Netlify release from this audit
